record.category: full VM (dedicated Linux VM per session)

free_tier.stated: Free trial: 'included usage allowance, up to 10 users, sandbox size up to xl, and priority support'. The size of the allowance and its duration are not stated on the pricing page.

retention.stated: unknown: 'Stopped, snapshotted, and otherwise non-running VMs do not accrue compute', and projects can cache reusable environments, but no page read states how long a stopped VM or its cached environment survives

egress.terms: Not published on the pricing page. Tembo Gateway model traffic and cloud VM compute 'draw from the same balance', but no traffic allowance or per-GB egress rate is stated.

record.interface_detail: Agent sessions execute in dedicated ephemeral Linux VMs; the workspace is driven through Tembo's own gateway and model routing rather than a machine you connect to directly.
record.tooling: Tembo's own workspace. It is a coding-agent product that happens to run a VM, not a VPS: no SSH contract is published on the pricing page.
record.chaining: A full VM at USD 0.1066 an hour for the smallest shape is USD 77.82 a month, so it is not an answer to the cheap-machine questions. It matters here as the case where a full VM is priced by the running second and the binding cost is the USD 60 a month plan that must sit underneath it.

limits.value: Pro USD 60 a month includes a USD 90 usage allowance; Max USD 200 includes USD 400; compute draws at USD 0.0403/vCPU-hour + USD 0.0130/GiB-RAM-hour
the Pro plan caps sandbox size at 'medium' (4 vCPU / 8 GiB); only Max and the trial reach 'xl' (16 vCPU / 32 GiB)

record.limits_note: 'Included monthly allowance expires at the end of each billing cycle and does not roll over. Prepaid balance does not expire.' Overage billing is optional and capped by a user-set maximum.
record.binding_note: The dollar allowance is what runs out first: the cheapest always-on shape spends USD 77.82 of it a month, inside a USD 90 Pro allowance, but a Medium VM at USD 0.2652 an hour uses up USD 90 in about 339 hours.

identity_cost.detail: Account signup for the free trial; Pro (USD 60) and Max (USD 200) are paid plans. Whether the trial requires a card, what card types are accepted, and whether any authorisation is held are not stated on the pricing page read.

record.reliability_note: no reliability event observed. Each session runs in a dedicated ephemeral VM, so state that is not in a cached project environment does not outlive the session.
record.confidence_note: Rates, the size table and the plan floors are quoted from the vendor's own pricing documentation read. The free-trial amount is explicitly unpublished, so no value is recorded for it. What would raise it: a trial run that reads the granted allowance, and the egress terms.

evidence.proved: quoted: 'VM compute ... at $0.0403/vCPU-hour + $0.0130/GiB-RAM-hour' with 'Nano | 2 | 2 GiB | $0.1066' per hour

metering: 'Tembo measures each running VM in seconds and bills its actual running time at the per-second equivalent of the hourly rate. Stopped, snapshotted, and otherwise non-running VMs do not accrue compute.'

evidence.proved: the trial ends by time or by allowance; neither the amount nor the length is stated

evidence.proved: the Pro plan costs USD 60 a month and carries a USD 90 usage allowance, so the allowance in the arithmetic is USD 90
evidence.quote: * Pro (\$60/month): \$90 monthly usage allowance, up to 5 users, sandbox size up to `medium`, with overage billing

record.notes: Arithmetic: Nano at USD 0.1066 an hour × 730 = USD 77.818 a month, against a USD 90 Pro allowance, so the allowance covers 844 hours. At 10 h a day (300 h) it is USD 31.98. Verified against the component rates: 2 × 0.0403 + 2 × 0.0130 = USD 0.1066 an hour, which matches the size table exactly. Larger shapes: Micro (2/4) USD 0.1326/hr, Medium (4/8) USD 0.2652, Large (8/16) USD 0.5304, XL (16/32) USD 1.0608, XXL (16/64) USD 1.4768, Ultra (32/128) USD 2.9536. Region, egress and stopped-VM retention are unverified. sandboxprices.com could not price this row at all, so the site contributes discovery only.

session_cap.note: no lifetime cap published; non-running VMs accrue no compute

extras.aggregator_note: sandboxprices.com lists Tembo Computer as a Full VM row with no modelled total ('workload eligibility incomplete'); the vendor rate card prices it at USD 77.82 a month for the smallest shape.
